name: What should I do immediately after my window shatters?

mainEntity.name: What should I do immediately after my window shatters?

acceptedAnswer.text: Immediately after your window shatters, prioritize safety. First, ensure everyone is away from the broken glass. If possible and safe, carefully cover the opening with a heavy blanket or tarp from the inside to prevent further glass fallout and temporary security. Do not attempt to remove large shards yourself unless wearing thick gloves and eye protection. Then, contact a professional like City Dweller for emergency board-up and replacement services. Avoid disturbing the area more than necessary.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prioritize safety by moving away from broken glass. If safe, cover the opening with a blanket or tarp. Then, contact a professional for emergency board-up and replacement services.
